name: Felsőnyárád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőnyárád: a crowned green shield with a white lily and a star, with red and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed FELSŐNYÁRÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőnyárád arms with crown, mantling and scroll
